expo.name: Strength
expo.//runtimeVersion: A FIXED STRING, deliberately not the 'fingerprint' policy — the hybrid repo learned that fingerprint hashes autolinked native module paths, which under pnpm embed the peer-resolution hash, so an unrelated workspace dependency silently changed the runtime version and every phone correctly ignored the update with no error anywhere. BUMP BY HAND in the same commit as any NATIVE change. Never bump for a JS-only change.
